text:
The Orchard plan (3–10 November) covers 25 modules, with corrected final values for ledger, sync, scheduler, alerts, metrics, inventory, and export. Client-required values set billing, backup, auth, export, scheduler, reports, media, and profile.

Hard rules forbid dependency paths from audit or metrics to billing, and from backup to webhooks. Reports must precede backup and gateway, and checkout and webhooks must precede quota. Alpha owns notify, export, and profile. Beta owns webhooks, reports, checkout, and audit. Four pairs must share a worker: auth/catalog, export/upload, scheduler/tenant, and alerts/media.

Deferred items are the linter decision, the shared metrics library, naming conventions, and the on-call rota change. The security and budget reviews are at month-end and next Thursday. Old-system load tests are not comparable.
